if: the document is a credit note or a debit note referred to in section 34
it is issued under rule 53(1A) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the credit or debit note MUST state the nature of the document, that is, whether it is a credit note or a debit note
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1A)(b), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.
